business_summary: Delek US Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: DK) is a merchant petroleum refiner, the cargo-owner/energy-importer anchor role on this chain. FY2025 companyfacts shows revenue of 10722900000, a thin 2.8% operating margin, net debt to EBITDA of 3.65x and a CLEAN Beneish read (-3.385). Its own Q2 2026 result reports benchmark crack spreads up 136% year over year and refining production margin rising to $569.6 million from $231.1 million, the anchor-link cost-and-margin dynamic this link measures.
